# Setup
``` {r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

# Datasets / Datasets Manipulation
```{r}
# load datasets
IEA_WEB   <- read_xlsx(here::here("data/IEA_WEB.xlsx"), sheet = "TimeSeries_1971-2024") 
OWB_WDI   <- read_csv(here::here("data/OWB_WDI.csv"))
OECD_STAN <- read_csv(here::here("data/OECD_STAN.csv"))

# load data from figures
STANFORD_4_2_1  <- read_csv(here::here("data/fig_4.2.1.csv"))
STANFORD_4_2_4  <- read_csv(here::here("data/fig_4.2.4.csv"))
STANFORD_4_2_11 <- read_csv(here::here("data/fig_4.2.11.csv"))
STANFORD_4_2_12 <- read_csv(here::here("data/fig_4.2.12.csv"))
STANFORD_4_3_12 <- read_csv(here::here("data/fig_4.3.12.csv"))

# combine figure data
STANFORD_INVEST <- STANFORD_4_2_1 %>%
  left_join(STANFORD_4_2_4,  by = "Year") %>%
  left_join(STANFORD_4_2_11, by = "Year")
  
STANFORD_DIFFUSION <- STANFORD_4_2_12 %>%
  left_join(STANFORD_4_3_12, by = join_by(Country == Economy)) %>%
  mutate(Label = case_when(
    Country == "United States" ~ "United States",
    Country == "China" ~ "China",
    TRUE ~ "Europe"
  ))

STANFORD <- STANFORD_INVEST %>% 
  left_join(STANFORD_DIFFUSION, by = "Label")
```
# Data
## 1. IEA
```{r}
# show data columns (not watermark)
IEA_WEB %>%
  select(-`Source: IEA (2025). All rights reserved. (https://www.iea.org/terms)`) %>%
  glimpse()
```

```

```

## 4. Stanford AI Index
```{r}
glimpse(STANFORD_INVEST)
glimpse(STANFORD_DIFFUSION)
glimpse(STANFORD)
```
